test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 24 men can complete a piece of work in 15 days working 8 h per day, then how many men will be required to complete the same work in 10 days working 6 h per day?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of men = 24

Number of days = 15

Working hours per day = 8

Number of days to complete the work = 10

Working hours per day = 6

**Formula Used:**

Work done = Number of men × Number of days × Working hours per day

Number of men required = Work done / (Number of days × Working hours per day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by 24 men in 15 days working 8 hours per day:

Work = 24 × 15 × 8

Work = 2880

Number of men required to complete the same work in 10 days working 6 hours per day:

Let the number of men required be M

Work = M × 10 × 6

2880 = M × 10 × 6

⇒ 2880 = 60M

⇒ M = 2880 / 60

⇒ M = 48

**The number of men required is 48.**
